MitSailingHome.meta_description: Sailing programs, events, and fleet at the MIT Sailing Pavilion.
MitSailingHome.hero_body: One of the finest university sailing programs in the world — open to MIT students, faculty, staff, and the public.

MitSailingHome.hours_sun_box: Sunset times and daily open hours follow the table. Team practices run on a separate schedule.

MitSailingDonate.heading: Giving to MIT Sailing
MitSailingDonate.intro_p1: Philanthropy advances MIT Sailing’s mission to prepare students for leadership, teamwork, and excellence on the water and beyond. Private support sustains our fleet and pavilion, strengthens varsity and recreational programs, and helps keep sailing accessible to every MIT student.
MitSailingDonate.intro_p2: Select a fund below to make a designated online gift. Foundations and corporate partners will find contact information and additional giving options on this page.
MitSailingDonate.corporate_body: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology welcomes philanthropic partnerships from foundations and corporations whose priorities align with MIT’s educational mission. Gifts may support instruction, facilities, equipment, and competition in ways that reflect shared objectives and Institute policies.
MitSailingDonate.corporate_contact_intro: To discuss foundation or corporate giving, please contact
MitSailingDonate.mailing_body: Stay updated on regattas, pavilion events, and our competitive season.
MitSailingDonate.volunteer_body: Become a mentor or race official to support our daily operations.
MitSailingDonate.alt_give_check_body: Make checks payable to Massachusetts Institute of Technology. On the memo line, write “MIT Sailing” or a specific fund from the list above. For the correct gift-processing address and any lockbox or payable-line requirements, contact Matt Lindblad at sailing@mit.edu—do not mail checks to the pavilion street address; it is not set up for gift processing.
MitSailingDonate.alt_give_wire_body: For domestic or international wire instructions, ACH details, and related account information, contact Matt Lindblad at sailing@mit.edu.
MitSailingDonate.alt_give_daf_body: To recommend a grant to MIT in support of sailing, contact Matt Lindblad at sailing@mit.edu for MIT’s legal name, employer identification number (EIN), and the wording Institute Advancement prefers on grant documentation.
MitSailingDonate.alt_give_securities_title: Gifts of stock, bonds, or other securities
MitSailingDonate.alt_give_securities_body: For transfer instructions, including DTC and account details for appreciated securities, contact Matt Lindblad at sailing@mit.edu.
MitSailingDonate.alt_give_contact_intro: We welcome the opportunity to discuss gift planning and other meaningful ways to support MIT Sailing.
MitSailingDonate.alt_give_legal: Gifts to MIT for Institute purposes may be tax-deductible as provided by law. For tax documentation, substantiation, or the Institute’s public charity status, contact Institute Advancement or email sailing@mit.edu; we can connect you with the right office.
